target_customer: Deep tech and hardware teams that buy parts and components, including across borders
problem: Hardware procurement means chasing suppliers, quotes, freight, customs and inventory by hand. Waybill runs it from request to stock under one approval and one payment.
business_model: Managed procurement service, likely a margin or fee on orders (not stated on the pages opened)
product_category: Agentic procurement and inventory for hardware

founders.name: Rishi Laddha
prior_employers: LAT Aerospace (operations, supply chain, government relations)
education: Plaksha University, BTech in CS and AI

competitors.name: Cofactr
competitors.what: BOM upload with agents and warehouses handling sourcing, ordering, storage, kitting and delivery for hardware teams
competitors.funding_then: 17.2M Series A led by Bain Capital Ventures (December 2024), about 28.8M total, per a search summary

competitors.name: Reframe
competitors.what: AI native hardware procurement marketplace for off the shelf and custom parts

competitors.name: Wizerr AI
competitors.what: Agentic BOM engine for electronics manufacturing

technical_complexity.rationale: Quote sourcing and negotiation agents are standard, but customs, freight and payments add operational and regulatory complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Supplier relationships and customs know-how can compound, but several funded competitors sell the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Hardware teams, especially in India, lose time to fragmented procurement and import paperwork; the company page claims end to end handling, evidence of demand is not independently shown.

branding.domain_note: Uses waybill.to, a .to domain, rather than waybill.com; date not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Procurement on autopilot, practical and operational

branding.community_and_virality: No community or press about the brand found. A waybill is a shipping document, so the name is a logistics term shared by others.

brand_strength.rationale: The name fits logistics but is a common noun with little distinctiveness or search ownership.

outcome_analysis: Waybill is a three person Summer 2026 company from Bengaluru automating hardware procurement. Founders have operations and supply chain backgrounds from LAT Aerospace and WareIQ. It is too new for an outcome and no shutdown or acquisition news was found. Funded rivals such as Cofactr and Reframe make execution and supplier access the key variables.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom shows a $125k seed with no investors, not recorded as a round. Team size conflicts (YC 3, Round Funded 5) and HQ conflicts (YC Bengaluru, Dealroom Gurugram). Cofactr funding figure comes from a search summary of company coverage. Completeness pass: the seed round rests on a single database (Dealroom, $125K, no investors or date). No press coverage of any round found.
